title: Graph shortest path (BFS)
hints: `AddEdge`: `if !slices.Contains(g[from], to) { g[from] = append(g[from], to) }` — reading a missing key gives a nil slice, which `append` handles. Then add `g[to] = []string{}` only if `to` is not already a key (comma-ok).
BFS uses a slice as a queue (`cur := queue[0]; queue = queue[1:]`) and a `dist map[string]int` that doubles as the visited set. Record `prev[n] = cur` when a node is first discovered.

To rebuild the path, start at `to` and follow `prev` until you reach `from`, appending each node; then `slices.Reverse(path)`. Wrap sentinels with `fmt.Errorf("%w: %q", ErrUnknownNode, n)` so `errors.Is` still matches.
